lang_en:
Tawang had been on our list for years.
We'd finally picked December.
I was about to pay.
She said, check NakshIQ first.
Tawang in December. Skip.
November. Eight out of ten.
Tawang's busiest month, too.
A month sooner, then. We booked November.
She circled it on our calendar.
And then we were standing in Tawang.
Her camera clicking, again and again.
Travel intelligence sometimes means going sooner, not later.
NakshIQ.
lang_hi:
तवांग सालों से हमारी लिस्ट में था।
आख़िरकार दिसंबर फ़ाइनल हुआ था।
मैं पेमेंट करने ही वाला था।
उसने कहा, पहले NakshIQ देख लो।
दिसंबर में तवांग। स्किप।
नवंबर। दस में से आठ।
और तवांग का सबसे भीड़ वाला महीना भी।
यानी एक महीना पहले। हमने नवंबर बुक किया।
उसने कैलेंडर पर नवंबर पर गोला बना दिया।
और फिर हम तवांग में खड़े थे।
उसका कैमरा, बार-बार क्लिक करता हुआ।
ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस का मतलब, कभी-कभी देर नहीं, जल्दी जाना।
NakshIQ.

cover.hook: We almost booked Tawang |in the *wrong month*.

shots: s1: Apartment, morning: the man (late 20s) at a laptop with his wallet out, about to pay, screen not visible.
s2: The woman (late 20s) rests her hand on his and holds up her phone; he stops.
s3: Close-up: both read her phone, screen glow on their faces, the screen never visible; he nods and closes the laptop.
s4: Tawang, morning: the two in warm jackets on a hillside road looking out over the town and the mountains, no one else in frame.
s5: Close-up: the woman raises her camera and shoots, the shutter clicking again and again.
s6: The two side by side; she shows him a photo on the camera's back screen, he smiles and puts an arm around her.
